string-array.name: quotes_morning
string-array.item: Only that day dawns to which we are awake.|Thoreau
Morning is when I am awake and there is a dawn in me.|Thoreau
The sun is new each day.|Heraclitus
Begin at once to live.|Seneca
One today is worth two tomorrows.|Benjamin Franklin
Arise, awake, and stop not till the goal is reached.|Vivekananda
Do tomorrow\'s work today, and today\'s work now.|Kabir
Well begun is half done.|Proverb

string-array.name: quotes_afternoon
string-array.item: Simplify, simplify.|Thoreau
Adopt the pace of nature: her secret is patience.|Emerson
Well done is better than well said.|Benjamin Franklin
Knowing is not enough; we must apply.|Goethe
The best way out is always through.|Robert Frost
Action is eloquence.|Shakespeare
Dripping water hollows out stone.|Ovid
Lost time is never found again.|Benjamin Franklin

string-array.name: quotes_evening
string-array.item: Rest belongs to the work as the eyelids to the eyes.|Tagore
Finish every day and be done with it.|Emerson
There is nothing like staying at home for real comfort.|Jane Austen
Rest is not idleness.|John Lubbock
Laugh, and the world laughs with you.|Ella Wheeler Wilcox
Hope is the thing with feathers.|Emily Dickinson
We must cultivate our garden.|Voltaire

string-array.name: quotes_night
string-array.item: The stars are not afraid to appear like fireflies.|Tagore
We are such stuff as dreams are made on.|Shakespeare
Tired nature\'s sweet restorer, balmy sleep!|Edward Young
O sleep, O gentle sleep, nature\'s soft nurse.|Shakespeare
It is always darkest just before the dawn.|Thomas Fuller
The night is the mother of counsel.|Proverb
A good conscience is a soft pillow.|Proverb
